mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a supply shock that will negatively impact corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO YoY growth drops below -2% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4%, an additional 25 basis point hike signals a hawkish Fed that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and FEDFUNDS increases by 25 bps
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% and hikes by 25 bps, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are below 800,000 units, a 10% YoY increase signals a strengthening housing market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 800,000 and YoY growth > 10%, but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 7%, a 0.5 percentage point drop signals an improving labor market that will boost consumer confidence and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 7% and UNRATE declines by 0.5 pp
failure_condition: UNRATE > 7% and drops by 0.5 pp, but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% YoY signals rising inflation that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 3% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Steady growth in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 4% YoY signals a healthy consumer sector that will support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS YoY growth > 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.
